_about: n-Octane (1) + p-Xylene (2): isobaric T-x-y at 20.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of n-octane, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of n-octane, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Yang, S.-K.[Sheng-Kai], Wang, X.[Xuejing], Zhu, Y.[Yong], Qiao, M.[Meiying], Chen, N.[Na], Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium data of the binary systems of octane with p, o, m-xylene at 20 kPa, Fluid Phase Equilib. 344 (2013) 1-5
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 9, 10. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Consistency point test (Redlich-Kister fit to T-x): mean |dy| 0.0016. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.12 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
